library_preparation_preflight.summary: No extra dependency or Docker image is needed; meaningful coverage requires registering BlackbirdModule with a Jackson mapper.
library_preparation_preflight.agent_guidance: Build a JsonMapper/ObjectMapper with new BlackbirdModule(), then exercise method-based POJO serialization and deserialization, including primitive, String, reference, setter, constructor, and @JsonCreator paths. Keep native tests enabled: Blackbird 3.1.5 intentionally skips optimizer registration in Native Image, so JVM tests exercise LambdaMetafactory paths while native tests validate the supported no-op path. Use a single mapper instance.
risks: Blackbird dynamically creates accessors on the JVM; modulepath or unusual class-loader scenarios may require custom lookup handling.
Each BlackbirdModule/ObjectMapper instance can retain generated lambda classes for its class loader.
